idea-plugin.name: ApiHelper
idea-plugin.description:
ApiHelper

A lightweight API assistant for Spring MVC, Spring Cloud OpenFeign, and Spring 6 @HttpExchange, built for endpoint navigation, endpoint browsing, and API debugging directly inside IntelliJ IDEA.

Features

  • Bidirectional gutter navigation between @FeignClient / @HttpExchange interfaces and @RestController methods.
  • API contract check — detects parameter-name mismatches, missing path variables, orphan endpoints, and duplicate mappings between the two sides, with editor highlighting, a report tab, and a one-click fix.
  • Reverse caller lookup — lists every Feign client calling a Controller method, something native Find Usages cannot see.
  • Controller gutter actions — right-click Controller gutter arrows to debug the endpoint or copy the resolved URL.
  • Endpoint explorer — browse Controller and Feign / HttpExchange endpoints from the ApiHelper tool window.
  • Markdown API docs — copy endpoint documentation with request parameters, request body fields, response fields, and descriptions from Javadocs or Swagger annotations.
  • API debugging — send HTTP requests with query, path, header, cookie, and body parameters.
  • Body modes — supports none, form-data, x-www-form-urlencoded, JSON, XML, raw, and binary requests.
  • Large payload friendly — streams file uploads and limits response preview size to reduce memory usage.
  • Spring configuration aware — automatically resolves server.servlet.context-path, spring.mvc.servlet.path, application-{profile}.yml and ${var:default} placeholders.
  • Java & Kotlin sources, courtesy of UAST.
  • Project-level caching with incremental refresh on PSI and Spring configuration changes.
  • Bilingual UI — English & Simplified Chinese bundle.

Compatibility

IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+ (build 243+). Requires the bundled Java and Kotlin plugins.

idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.1

  • Added the official JetBrains Marketplace error reporter: IDE exceptions and UI freezes caused by the plugin can now be submitted with stack traces and thread dumps, helping issues surface faster. Only diagnostic stacks are reported — no source code, project data, or personal information is collected.

1.2.0

  • New Contract tool window tab that reports protocol mismatches between Feign / HttpExchange and Controller endpoints, grouped by severity, with Markdown export.
  • Editor inspection highlighting contract issues on both sides for Java and Kotlin, suppressible via //noinspection ApiHelperContract.
  • Quick fix that synchronizes a Feign parameter name with the name the Controller expects.
  • Show Callers action on Controller methods, listing every Feign client that calls the endpoint.
  • P0 rules: orphan endpoints, explicit @RequestParam name mismatches, missing @PathVariable parameters, and duplicate path + HTTP method mappings.

1.1.1

  • Promoted Debug to a top-level native tool window tab alongside Interfaces, Base URL, History, and Global Params.
  • Redesigned the Debug tab with a top-and-bottom split layout (Request configuration on top, Response display on bottom), rounded pill sub-tabs, and line-numbered code areas.
  • Upgraded Base URL tab with direct checkbox-based active environment selection and one-click preset templates (Local / Dev / Test).
  • Expanded Global Params tab to support global Headers, Query, and Cookies via rounded pill sub-tabs, preserving per-row enable/disable states.
  • Enhanced History tab with keyword search, a bottom live preview pane, context menu actions, and single-entry deletion.
  • Redesigned Settings → Tools → ApiHelper with grouped sections and embedded visual tables for environments and global parameters.
  • Reduced global UI font sizes and row heights for a more compact, crisp IDE-native appearance.

1.1.0

  • Redesigned the tool window workspace: top-level native tabs (Interfaces, Base URL, History, Global Params) and collapsible Interfaces / Debug split panes inside the main workspace.
  • Added global Search API Endpoint popup (Navigate → Search API Endpoint..., Ctrl+Alt+\ / Cmd+Opt+\, and tool window header action): press Enter to jump to source, Shift+Enter to jump to counterpart, or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to open in the debugger.
  • Added global common headers and multi-environment Base URL configuration under Settings → Tools → ApiHelper and dedicated tool window tabs, with an environment switcher in the API debugger.
  • Added one-click Copy as cURL in the endpoint tree context menu, Controller editor gutter menu, and API debugger, plus Copy API Docs directly in the Controller gutter menu.
  • Added project-level Debug Draft Persistence & Reset per endpoint and Debug Request History (up to 30 recent requests with one-click replay of request and response).
  • Added Group by Module toggle, Pairing Status Filter (All / Paired Only / Unpaired Orphan Only), paired status indicators on tree nodes, and Select Opened Endpoint toolbar action.
  • Added recursive JSON request body generation for nested DTOs and collections, honoring @JsonProperty field names and @Schema(example) / @ApiModelProperty(example) values, plus custom composite meta-annotation (e.g. @ApiRestController) recognition.

1.0.4

  • Fixed deprecated IntelliJ Platform API usages (CommonProxy and DynamicBundle(String)) for full compatibility with IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 EAP.
  • Upgraded tool window search bar to native SearchTextField with clear button and ESC shortcut to dismiss, plus TreeSpeedSearch type-to-filter on endpoint trees.
  • Added filtered/total endpoint counts on Controller and Feign tabs, and parameter counts on Debug request tabs (Query, Path, Headers, Cookies).
  • Added "Jump to Source" in endpoint tree context menus and unified balloon notifications for copy/navigation actions.
  • Improved API debugger UX: auto-commit table edits on focus loss, press Enter in URL field to send, semantic status code coloring, automatic response body type detection, and one-click response copy.

1.0.3

  • Fixed counterpart matching failing entirely in projects with a configured server.servlet.context-path; matching now uses the relative path without the context-path.
  • Fixed matching failures when path variable names differ between the two sides, e.g. {id} vs {userId}.
  • Fixed a brief empty-cache window during full cache rebuilds that caused gutter icon flicker; caches are now replaced atomically.
  • Debug requests can now be cancelled while sending, and honor the IDE global HTTP proxy settings.
  • Debug connect and request timeouts are now configurable under Settings → Tools → ApiHelper.
  • Counterpart matching queries now use an inverted index for O(1) lookups, and PSI-driven cache rebuilds are debounced.

1.0.2

  • Added a native IDE-style endpoint context menu with "Copy API Docs".
  • API docs now generate standard Markdown and include endpoint metadata, descriptions, Path / Query / Header / Cookie parameters, request body fields, and response fields.
  • API docs extract field and parameter descriptions from Javadocs, @param, and Swagger annotations.
  • DTO parameters are expanded for Query and request body sections, including @SpringQueryMap / @QueryMap.
  • Generic response wrappers such as DllResult<T>, DllPageResult<T>, and List<T> are expanded into fields such as data[].field and records[].field.
  • Improved multi-keyword endpoint search and manual endpoint refresh behavior.
  • Optimized large file debug requests by streaming binary and form-data uploads.
  • Limited debug response body preview to the first 5 MB to reduce memory usage.
  • Fixed transient IntelliJ index and PSI-change issues during endpoint refresh.

1.0.1

  • Removed debugger entry from Feign / HttpExchange endpoint list context menus.
  • Automatically prefill Path, Query, Header, Cookie, and JSON Body draft parameters when opening the debugger from an endpoint.
  • Controller gutter context menus now support both debugging the endpoint and copying the resolved URL.
  • Feign / HttpExchange gutter icons keep left-click navigation only, with no context-menu actions.

1.0.0

  • Initial ApiHelper release.
  • Added Spring MVC Controller, OpenFeign, and @HttpExchange endpoint navigation.
  • Added endpoint explorer and lightweight API debugger in the ApiHelper tool window.
  • Added Query, Path, Header, Cookie, form-data, x-www-form-urlencoded, JSON, XML, raw, and binary request support.
  • Added Spring configuration resolution for context path, servlet path, profile, server port, and placeholders.
  • Added Java and Kotlin source support via UAST.
  • English & Simplified Chinese bundle.
